summary: TypeScript code is well-structured with clear separation of concerns and proper async/await handling. Workflow uses pinned action versions (@v4, @v2) and least-privilege permissions. Critical gaps: (1) No actionlint validation run in workflow or pre-delivery (task requires 'actionlint .github/workflows/semantic-version-bumper.yml'); (2) Workflow lacks mechanism to generate required act-result.txt artifact; (3) workflow doesn't accept test fixture data or run multiple test cases; (4) Format coupling: git log parser and Keep-a-Changelog format are hard-coded, limiting pluggability; (5) parseArgs() (bump-version.ts:29) doesn't validate date format; (6) version file JSON detection (src/version-file.ts:28) uses try-catch that could mask parse errors. Workflow otherwise sound—runs unit tests, scopes them correctly, reports outputs properly.
